summary: Server event (registry does not mark it one-frame) of esv::party::DataSystem (macOS index: writers DataSystem::Update / ProcessRecipeRequests): a party member was attached to another group. Created on a fresh event entity by bg3.exe+0x2BC2690 when the old and new 16-byte group values differ; read by esv::StoryCharacterEventManager::Init (Osiris events). Seen.py context: party changes (recruiting / dismissing companions, summons).

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2BC5370 (AllocRaw 0x18) default null handle at +0; bg3.exe+0x2BC2690 line ~104 writes the member entity. Live (6): entity handles.

fields.name: Group
fields.evidence: Creator zeroes +8/+0x10; bg3.exe+0x2BC2690 returns early when param_5 == param_6 (two 16-byte values compared as two qwords) and writes param_6 (the new value) here. 16-byte value compared and copied as a pair of qwords: a group Guid. Live: always zero (attached to the default/empty group).

open_questions: Whether +8 is the new group Guid or another 16-byte id (always zero live).
